zero_to_60.source: Trusted road tests (Car and Driver first; MotorTrend or Edmunds where noted). Read Nov 14, 2026 through the pages listed per model. Show on the site with an info icon and the source.
zero_to_60.note: Independent test results, not Honda figures. Honda does not publish 0-60 times. Most Car and Driver numbers were read from pages that report the test, not from caranddriver.com itself; confirm before publishing. Trims without a test are left empty.
civic-sedan: Hybrid (Sport Touring Hybrid sedan): 6.2 sec, Car and Driver instrumented test | https://www.aol.com/articles/honda-civic-car-driver-2026-140000342.html
Gas 2.0 L (2025 Sport sedan): 8.9 sec, Car and Driver instrumented test, as reported by Carscoops | https://www.carscoops.com/?p=3299704
civic-hatchback: Hybrid (2025 Sport Touring Hybrid hatchback): 6.1 sec, MotorTrend test as cited by the Wall Street Journal; Edmunds measured 7.4 sec on the same trim | https://www.edmunds.com/car-news/long-term/2025-honda-civic-hybrid.html
Gas 2.0 L hatchback: no test found
civic-si-sedan: 6.8 sec (2025 Civic Si), Car and Driver instrumented test: the 2026 10Best article puts the hybrid's 6.2 sec 0.6 sec ahead of the last Si tested. An earlier long-term Si ran 6.6 sec | https://www.aol.com/articles/honda-civic-car-driver-2026-140000342.html
civic-type-r: 4.9 sec (2023 Civic Type R), Car and Driver instrumented test, as reported by KSL Cars and SlashGear | https://cars.ksl.com/resources/car-review/2023-honda-civic-type-r-test-drive-review
accord-sedan: Hybrid (2025 Accord Hybrid Touring): 6.7 sec, Car and Driver instrumented test, as reported by the Philadelphia Inquirer | https://www.inquirer.com/columnists/2025-honda-accord-hybrid-performance-comfort-efficiency-20251106.html
Gas 1.5 L turbo (LX, SE): no test of the current generation found
prelude: 6.5 sec (2026 Prelude); 7.3 sec with S+ Shift on. Car and Driver instrumented test | https://www.aol.com/articles/honda-prelude-really-slower-civic-145800097.html
hr-v: 9.4 sec (2023 HR-V EX-L), Car and Driver instrumented test as listed by 0-60specs.com; MotorTrend measured 9.8 sec | https://www.0-60specs.com/honda/hr-v-0-60-times
cr-v: Hybrid (2026 Sport Touring Hybrid AWD): 7.1 sec; TrailSport Hybrid: 7.3 sec. Car and Driver instrumented test as listed by 0-60specs.com. Edmunds measured 8.0 sec on the Sport Touring Hybrid | https://www.0-60specs.com/honda-cr-v-0-60-times
Gas 1.5 L turbo (2023 test): 8.3 sec, Car and Driver instrumented test, read from a copy of the article; confirm on caranddriver.com
passport: TrailSport Elite: 7.3 sec; RTL: 7.1 sec (2026 Passport). Car and Driver instrumented test as listed by 0-60specs.com; MotorTrend measured 7.7 sec on the TrailSport Elite | https://www.0-60specs.com/honda/passport-0-60-times
pilot: 7.2 sec (2023 Pilot Elite AWD, same engine and generation), Car and Driver instrumented test, as reported by Road & Track | https://www.aol.com/finance/tested-2026-honda-pilot-elite-144500497.html
odyssey: 6.4 sec (2025 Odyssey Elite), Car and Driver instrumented test, as reported by The Autopian; MotorTrend measured 6.8 sec | https://www.theautopian.com/the-honda-odyssey-is-the-fastest-car-no-one-will-ever-guess-is-fast/
ridgeline: 6.0 sec (2024 Ridgeline TrailSport), Car and Driver instrumented test | https://autos.yahoo.com/tested-2024-honda-ridgeline-trailsport-123100029.html
prologue: AWD dual motor (2024 Prologue Elite AWD): 5.9 sec, Car and Driver instrumented test | https://autos.yahoo.com/2024-honda-prologue-better-ev-140000998.html
